title: Prompting Time plugin manifest, version 1
description: What Prompting Time reads from a plugin's prompting-time-plugin.json to install, check, start, configure, and show it. docs/plugin-contract.md says what Prompting Time expects of the commands it names. Paths are relative to the plugin's folder and stay inside it: no leading /, and no . or .. component. Prompting Time also checks what a schema cannot: that the start command and every action's command are executable files, that the settings file holds a JSON object, that action names are unique, that a manifest with a prerequisite's only_when has a get-settings action, and that status.item_actions name declared actions.

manifest_version.description: The number of this manifest format.

name.description: The plugin's ID. It names the plugin's folder, its state folder ($XDG_STATE_HOME/<name>), and its page's address, pt-plugin://<name>/.

start.description: The command Prompting Time starts when it opens, unless a copy already holds the run lock, and stops when it quits: a path, then its arguments.

prerequisites.description: The programs Prompting Time looks for on the PATH it gives plugin commands before it starts the plugin.

command.description: A program name, such as gh.

purpose.description: Why the plugin needs it, for the message when it is missing.

only_when.description: The program is needed only when one of the values in the settings object `setting` is `value`, as the get-settings action prints the settings: {"setting": "jobs", "value": "devin"} holds for {"jobs": {"review": "devin"}}.

entry.description: The page's HTML file, in a folder of its own inside the plugin's folder, such as page/dist/index.html. Prompting Time serves every file in that folder to the page, and nothing outside it.

protocol.description: The page protocol the page speaks: 2, in which the page runs the manifest's actions itself.

status.description: What the status action prints in status format 2, which docs/plugin-status-v2.schema.json describes: the groups its items go in, and the actions their rows offer.

id.description: What each item names as its group; unique among the groups.

needs_you.description: Whether the group's items wait on the user, which lists them under Needs you.

order.description: Where the group lists among the plugin's groups, lowest first.

item_actions.description: The actions an item's row may offer, each one of the manifest's actions. Prompting Time runs one as its command, then --item and the item's id.

settings.description: The path of the JSON Schema of the settings, from which Prompting Time draws its settings form.

actions.description: The commands Prompting Time runs. Some names have a meaning of their own; see docs/plugin-contract.md.

command.description: A path and its fixed arguments; Prompting Time adds the rest, such as a run ID.

confirm.description: Prompting Time runs the action only after the user confirms what it will do, as docs/plugin-contract.md describes; for an action that acts outside this Mac, such as posting to GitHub.
